extDescription.message: QoL extras for Edupage - themes, grade tools, attendance stats, and timetable export.

shortcutUnavailable.message: Shortcut status unavailable in this browser.

menuUpdateHint.message: Pull the latest project from GitHub.

menuUpdateNotice.message: Downloaded version: $local$. Latest GitHub version: $latest$. Pull the latest project from GitHub.

settingsSubtitle.message: Find and adjust the changes Edupage Extras makes.

experimentalConfirmBody.message: This section holds features still in development. They may be unstable, change without notice, or in rare cases corrupt or lose locally stored data. Continue only if you're comfortable with that risk.

themesDesc.message: Recolor EduPage and the extension menus with your selected theme.

themeHotkeyDesc.message: Open your browser's shortcut settings to assign a key combination for turning the theme on or off.

themeDesc.message: Choose the colors Edupage Extras applies to Edupage.

themeDisclaimerText.message: During an online test or exam, a recolored EduPage looks different from the standard page — which can draw a teacher's attention or be mistaken for tampering. Switch to the default theme (or turn themes off) while you take the test.

etestAutoThemeOffDesc.message: When Stay Active Mode is enabled, automatically switch to the default (light) look while an eTest is open, and restore your theme when it closes.

customThemeDesc.message: Build your own Edupage Extras colors.

customThemePlaceholder.message: Paste a shared Edupage Extras custom theme here.

customThemeReadyToCopy.message: Custom theme is ready to copy.

centeredLayoutDesc.message: Keep the schedule and main EduPage content centered on wide screens.

hideHelpTextDesc.message: Remove EduPage's greeting and help message from the top-right corner.

timetableHighlightsDesc.message: Use separate colors for substitutions and room changes in the home-page timetable.

gradeBadgesDesc.message: Show subject-average badges, visual bars, and an overall average at the bottom of Grades.

subjectAttendanceDesc.message: Show each subject's absence percentage and lesson totals directly on the Grades page.

attendancePercentagesDesc.message: Add the current half-year absence percentage to EduPage's standalone Attendance summary.

secondHalfStartDesc.message: Override when the second halfyear begins for attendance calculations. Leave this empty to use EduPage's default date for the current school year.

secondHalfEndDesc.message: Override when the second halfyear ends for predicted attendance in grades. Leave this empty to use EduPage's default end date for the current school year.

autoLoginDesc.message: Continue through EduPage's saved-account login after your browser fills the password. It stops immediately if you type or choose an account yourself.

autoLoginPreferredAccountDesc.message: When several saved accounts appear, enter part of the account name that Automatic Login should select. Leave blank to choose manually.

ucivoExportDesc.message: Add TXT and CSV download buttons to each subject's Učivo page, including taught dates.

timetableExportDesc.message: Show options for downloading your timetable as an ICS calendar file.

etestCopyDesc.message: Add structured copy actions to EduPage tests (eTest), including a button for the whole numbered test.

etestQuestionButtonsDesc.message: Show a copy button beside every question.

etestWholeTestButtonDesc.message: Show the action that copies every question collected from the current test.

etestIncludeAnswersDesc.message: Mark selected choices and include typed, dropdown, matching, or ordering answers in copied questions.

toggleEtestIncludeAnswers.message: Toggle selected answers in copied questions

etestIncludeImagesDesc.message: Keep question images when pasting the whole test into apps that support rich content.

etestImageExportDesc.message: Paste copied test text to download a readable PNG. The text stays on this device.

etestImageExportTooLong.message: This text is too long for one image.

mobileResponsiveDesc.message: Adapt EduPage layouts, tables, navigation, and text for smaller screens. This is still being tested across different pages.

mobileRedirectDesc.message: When enabled, opening Edupage on a phone jumps straight to your school's /app/main mobile view. Leave this off on desktop.

previewUpdateToastDesc.message: Show the update notice on an open EduPage tab without installing another version.

gradesDebugDesc.message: Write technical attendance loading and matching details to the browser console for troubleshooting.

reportProblemDesc.message: If a feature misbehaves on your school's EduPage, generate a diagnostic report so the issue can be fixed without access to your account. Open the affected EduPage page in another tab first, then generate the report.

reportRedactNote.message: When enabled, the report includes page structure (tags, classes, layout) but no grades, names, marks, or other text values.

exportTimetableDesc.message: Download your timetable as an .ics file for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, etc. Briefly opens a hidden EduPage tab to read the timetable.

exportExcludedRangesDesc.message: The half-year export already skips public holidays and the common Slovak/Czech school breaks. Paste extra dates or ranges to skip (one per line), e.g. your region's spring break: 2026-02-16 - 2026-02-20 or 16.2.2026 - 20.2.2026.

exportTimetableIncludeChangesDesc.message: Keep this week's substitutions and room changes in the export.

exportTimetableEdupageTip.message: Tip: EduPage also has its own calendar subscription, no extension needed — My Profile → Calendar Settings → Download ICS/WebCal (Môj profil → Nastavenia kalendára → Stiahnuť ICS/WebCal).

reportReady.message: Report ready. Review it, then copy, download, or open an issue.

reportNoTab.message: Report ready, but no EduPage tab was found — open the affected page in another tab and regenerate for page details.

reportEmpty.message: Report ready, but no recognizable EduPage content was captured — open the page that is actually broken (grades, timetable, attendance) and regenerate.

reportCopyManual.message: Could not copy automatically — the report is selected, press Ctrl/Cmd+C.

reportIssueOpened.message: Opened a new GitHub issue — attach the downloaded report or paste it in.

updateRemindersDesc.message: Check GitHub for newer versions when this extension was installed manually.

updateToastBody.message: See what changed in this version.

noUpdateCheck.message: No update check has run yet.

updatesAutoStore.message: This install updates automatically through your browser's add-on store.

updateReloadReminder.message: After pulling the latest project, also reload the unpacked extension in chrome://extensions/.

updateAvailableStatus.message: Downloaded version: $local$. Latest GitHub version: $latest$. Pull the latest project from GitHub.$reload$ Checked $time$.

updateUpToDateStatus.message: Downloaded version: $local$. Latest GitHub version: $latest$. Checked $time$.

experimentalSubtitle.message: Test activity and visibility protections on Edupage pages.

samDesc.message: Controls how Edupage sees tab activity, focus, mouse movement, and clipboard actions. Changes apply live, but reloading open Edupage tabs gives the cleanest start.

samMasterDesc.message: Turn the full Stay Active feature set on or off at once for Edupage pages.

samHotkeyDesc.message: Optional. No default hotkey is assigned. Use Chrome's extension shortcuts page if you want a shortcut for toggling Stay Active Mode.

keepVisibleDesc.message: Make Edupage read the tab as visible even after switching away.

toggleKeepNotHidden.message: Toggle keep tab marked not hidden

hideTabSwitchDesc.message: Stop Edupage scripts from receiving visibility and page-hide events.

keepFocusedDesc.message: Make Edupage read the page as focused and hide focus-in events.

hideFocusLossDesc.message: Stop Edupage scripts from receiving blur and focus-out events.

hideCursorLeaveDesc.message: Stop Edupage scripts from seeing mouse enter and leave events.

toggleHideCursorLeave.message: Toggle hide cursor leaving the page

hideCursorMoveDesc.message: Stop Edupage scripts from seeing mouse over and out events.

toggleHideCursorMove.message: Toggle hide cursor moving between areas

hidePointerCaptureDesc.message: Stop Edupage scripts from seeing pointer capture and release events.

hideClipboard.message: Hide Copy, Paste, Selection, And Dragging

hideClipboardDesc.message: Stop Edupage scripts from seeing clipboard, context menu, selection, drag, and drop events.

toggleHideClipboard.message: Toggle hide copy paste selection and dragging

blockEscKeyDesc.message: Stop the Escape key from reaching Edupage scripts (e.g. exiting a test's fullscreen mode).

jquerySweepDesc.message: Periodically strip the eTest player's own jQuery activity-tracking listeners from the page and window.

toggleJquerySweep.message: Toggle disable test player event listeners

fullscreenSpoofDesc.message: Stop the eTest player from reacting when fullscreen is exited.

stopRedirectsDesc.message: Try to block reload redirects that start after Edupage becomes hidden.

keepAnimation.message: Keep Page Animation Running In Background

keepAnimationDesc.message: Keep requestAnimationFrame callbacks moving while the tab is hidden.

toggleKeepAnimation.message: Toggle keep page animation running in background

showStatusDotDesc.message: Show a small dot so users can see whether Stay Active Mode is active or paused.

showConsoleDebugDesc.message: Print technical diagnostics in the page console when something cannot be changed.

maintenanceDesc.message: Reset restores the experimental defaults and keeps Stay Active Mode turned off.

shortcutSettingsFirefoxHint.message: Firefox manages shortcuts on the about:addons page — click the gear icon there and choose "Manage Extension Shortcuts".

gradesSortFilterDesc.message: Add subject search, sorting options, and a control for hiding subjects without grades above the Grades table.

gradesExportDesc.message: Add CSV, TXT, and JSON downloads above the Grades table with subjects, dates, values, weights, titles, and averages.

attDetailFormula.message: Formula: absent / (present + absent). Distant lessons (school activities, trips, sick-bay) are excluded from the denominator to match the school's report.

vgMassOverrideTitle.message: Manual override (auto-detected: $1). Clear or set to $1 to use auto-detection.

vgMassBlobTitle.message: Read from EduPage's own grade weights (p_váha). Edit if it's wrong.

vgMassSubrowTitle.message: Auto-detected from EduPage's category sub-rows (Váha udalosti). Edit if it's wrong.

vgMassUnknownTitle.message: Auto-detection still running, or couldn't find weight info on this skin. Type the correct weight to override.

gradesOfficialHalf.message: Official current halfyear: $1/$2 lessons absent in total.

gradesOfficialHalfUnmatched.message: Official current halfyear: $1/$2 lessons absent in total. $3/$4 additional lessons are not mapped to grades rows yet.

gradesAttendanceLoading.message: Current halfyear attendance data is still loading.

gradesAttendanceStillLoading.message: Official current-halfyear attendance data is still loading.

gradesAttendanceUnavailable.message: Official current-halfyear attendance data is not available yet.

gradesPredictedLoading.message: Predicted end-of-halfyear attendance is still loading.

gradesPredictedUnavailable.message: Predicted end-of-halfyear attendance is not available yet.

gradesPredictedSummary.message: If you miss no more lessons this halfyear, the projected absence total is $1/$2.

gradesColAbsPercentTitle.message: Current halfyear absence percentage per subject.

gradesColAbsTotalTitle.message: Current halfyear absent lessons / lessons held so far per subject.

gradesColPredAbsPercentTitle.message: Projected end-of-halfyear absence percentage if you miss no more lessons.

gradesColPredAbsTotalTitle.message: Projected absent lessons / projected total lessons by the end of the current halfyear if you miss no more lessons.

gradesRowUnmatched.message: Current halfyear ($1) data was not matched to this grades row.

gradesRowPredictedUnmatched.message: Projected end-of-halfyear ($1) data was not matched to this grades row.

gradesRowTooltip.message: Current halfyear ($1): $2/$3 lessons absent. Formula: absent / lessons held so far in the halfyear.

gradesRowPredictedTooltip.message: If you miss no more lessons this $1, the projected end-of-halfyear total is $2/$3.
